summary: Codere Online Luxembourg filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Q2 2026 earnings press release and presentation. The filing reports record quarterly net gaming revenue of EUR 69.4 million (up 27% YoY), Adjusted EBITDA of EUR 5.8 million, total cash of EUR 62.6 million, and no financial debt. The company raised its FY 2026 net gaming revenue outlook to EUR 255-265 million and Adj. EBITDA to EUR 20-25 million. This is a routine earnings announcement with no special-situations elements such as M&A, capital structure changes, or strategic reviews. The content is purely operational and financial results disclosure, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
